caveats: No table-based release exists for 2006-2010. A table's cells sit inside a numbered sequence file; Start Position in the lookup file is the 1-based field of line 1, counting the 6 header fields (FILEID, FILETYPE, STUSAB, CHARITER, SEQUENCE, LOGRECNO).
Rows are keyed by LOGRECNO; GEOID comes from the geography file. The Tracts_Block_Groups_Only archive holds the tract rows.
No negative jam sentinels appear in Virginia tract rows of the sequences used; missing values are '.' or blank instead. The numeric jam guard still runs.
B15003 does not exist in 2006-2010; education uses B15002 (sex by educational attainment).

county.note: Counties and county-equivalents. Virginia's 38 independent cities are county-equivalents here.

place.note: Incorporated towns and cities plus census-designated places (CDPs). Places do not cover the whole state.

zcta.note: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas. The 2016-2020 ACS still tabulates 2010 ZCTA definitions (33,120 nationally; 2020 ZCTAs arrive with the 2018-2022 release). National rows with no state; each is assigned to one state by the zcta_state rule for 2010 ZCTAs.

caveats: Official table-based Summary File: the same data-file layout as the 2016-2020 prototype; geography and shell files are pipe-delimited.

Connecticut: from the 2022 releases on, Census tabulates Connecticut by its nine planning regions (county-equivalents 09110-09190) and renumbers its tracts' county part to match. Connecticut counties and tracts are therefore not comparable by GEOID to earlier periods without the Census CT crosswalk.

county.note: Counties and county-equivalents. Virginia's 38 independent cities are county-equivalents here.

place.note: Incorporated towns and cities plus census-designated places (CDPs). Places do not cover the whole state.

zcta.note: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas, 2020 definitions (the 2018-2022 release on). National rows, assigned to one state by the 2020 zcta_state rule.

2010.rule: The state holding the largest share of the ZCTA's 2010 population (POPPT); land area (AREALANDPT) where it has none. Ties go to the lower state FIPS.

2020.rule: The state holding the largest share of the ZCTA's land (AREALAND_PART). For ACS releases that tabulate 2020 ZCTAs (2018-2022 on).
